title: M7.P5: Recognize completed phased audits in ceremony checks
body:
The completed M7.P4 fixes audit (#471) is not recognized by `tools/ceremony-check`.
The live gate still reports 95 completed closures since 2026-10-04 after all
eight findings and twelve related software issues have closed with published
evidence and exact readbacks.

The detector only recognizes an `Audit`/`Code audit` title prefix or a hyphenated
date directory. Current audit artifacts use `2026_10_06-...` and phase-prefixed
titles. It also counts whole days, so the closures resolved by an audit can
immediately retrigger the 12-closure threshold on its completion day.

Keep the existing 12-closure/14-day policy. Record a structured completed-audit
receipt bound to the real resolution artifacts and closed tracker readback;
validate that evidence before advancing the clock, then count closures after
its exact completion time. Incomplete, malformed, future-dated or changed
evidence must not satisfy the audit gate. Preserve legacy marker support.

Can this be done on the VM? No: this concerns repository evidence and GitHub
ceremony accounting. Use isolated host fixtures and live tracker readback.

- [x] A complete validated receipt advances the audit clock to its actual
  completion time, with the qualifying artifacts and issue named in output.
- [x] Controls reject incomplete, stale/tampered, future-dated and malformed
  receipts, and count only closures after completion without changing cadence.
- [x] The live checker recognizes the completed #471 audit, with its output
  retained; normal rules/register/index checks remain green.

Already written: no player or cloud state is affected. The original gate
warning and audit evidence remain retained; this does not repeat an external
review, waive findings, or designate a release candidate.


Completed on next `96c877f617d82a35cb09e93f6408b8fea76142ea`. [Fifteen controls and old/new live gate proof](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/96c877f617d82a35cb09e93f6408b8fea76142ea/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-audit-cadence). The actual resolution linter passes and the live checker reports nothing overdue. Ordinary publication verified all four result channels, 211 seals, owner exits and exact remote refs. No external audit replay or product change.
